definitions.explanation: Having no selfish desires or ambition. Describes a person or attitude that is not driven by personal gain. Generally a positive quality.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{無欲|むよく}な{人|ひと}だ。
{無欲|むよく}に{働|はたら}く{姿|すがた}が{周|まわ}りから{尊敬|そんけい}されている。
examples.english: Her selfless dedication to work is respected by those around her.

examples.japanese: {無欲|むよく}であることが、かえって{良|よ}い{結果|けっか}を{生|う}むこともある。
examples.english: Being free from greed can actually produce good results.

notes:
USAGE:
{無欲|むよく} is generally used as a positive descriptor, suggesting purity of intention and lack of selfish motives. It can function as a na-adjective ({無欲|むよく}な) or as a noun.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無欲|むよく}な{人|ひと} (a selfless person)
- {無欲|むよく}に{生|い}きる (to live without greed)
- {無欲|むよく}の{勝利|しょうり} (a victory achieved without attachment to winning)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{欲張|よくば}り is the opposite — a greedy person. {無私|むし} means selfless or disinterested and is more literary. {淡泊|たんぱく} means indifferent or detached, with a more neutral tone.
